title: What jobs do you think ChatGPT Astra/Sol are good for?
author: Stunning-Pizza3375
selftext: I have a Claude 200 plan and a ChatGPT 200 plan but feel generally Claude is much better so want to figure out what kinds of work I should be giving to ChatGPT

comments.author: bebopbraunbaer
comments.body: I like to use it to review the other models and vice versa, always get a better result that way than claude reviewing claude

comments.author: ATurbulentDrop
comments.body: I find "computer use" functionality to be miles ahead with Codex compared to Claude Code. Basically, if you need to control your computer to do a task, Codex does much better. I also prefer Sol's writing style over Opus's, even with the most recent Opus 5.5 improvements.

replies.author: Upstairs_Tone_4227
replies.body: What are these recent improvements you’re talking about?

replies.author: ATurbulentDrop
replies.body:
>We’ve made major improvements to the way Opus 5.5 writes and communicates, one of the most common areas of feedback we heard about Opus 5. Its messages are much easier to understand at a glance, which testers said helped during long working sessions. It puts the most important information up front, is less likely to use jargon or idiosyncratic phrases, and follows the writing rules you give it. We find that this makes Opus 5.5 a noticeably better collaborator. 

From [https://www.anthropic.com/claude-opus-5-5#performance-and-cost-effectiveness](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-opus-5-5#performance-and-cost-effectiveness)
